title: Help make VocabX better
text: VocabX is still very young, and your impressions decide what it becomes next.
inviteTitle: Level {level} already — you know VocabX inside out!
inviteText: You have got to know the app well, so your opinion matters especially now. Spare a minute — it will help the development enormously.
valuable: Every piece of feedback is incredibly valuable to us: we read everything ourselves, and your answers decide what we improve and add first.
anonymous: Everything is sent anonymously: no name, e-mail or IP address is collected — only your answers, the interface language and your level.
bugTextPlaceholder: What you did and what you saw instead of what you expected
emptyText: Please write at least a few words.

survey.title: Short survey
survey.text: 10 ratings and a few taps — about two minutes. Helps the most.

bug.title: Found a bug?
bug.text: Something not working right? Tell us where — we will fix it.

idea.title: Suggest an idea
idea.text: What are you missing? The best ideas make it into the next versions.

survey.text: 10 quick ratings from 1 to 5 and a few taps — about two minutes. Every answer shows us exactly what to improve.
